intro.text: A listener. When Venli leaves Urithiru to look for the listeners, Rlain asks her to pass on his regards to Harvo and Thude if they are still alive.

items.text: Harvo was one of the listeners and lived through at least most of the war on the Shattered Plains. Rlain, unsure whether he was still alive, sent his regards with Venli when she went in search of their people.
